# FLX-3674: a forecasts confidence needs more sweep runs than the engine allows

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The sweep of a forecast needs the least whole number of runs R with R (1 - c) / 2 at least 1, which is 2 / (1 - c) rounded up, so a confidence c close to 1 needs a very long sweep: 0.99998 needs 100,000. A confidence that needs more than 100,000 runs is refused where the forecasts block is read, naming the block, since no sweep could be run for it. Declare a lower confidence.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3674
```
